title: Akbar tujhe madar ki nazar dhoond rahi hai
body:
1. akbar tujhe madar ki nazar dhoond rahi hai.
apni wo duao’n ka asar dhoond rahi hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. akbar sue maidaan na tu ja mere beta.
barchi ki ani tera jigar dhoond rahi hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. armane jigar qat mein likhe dar pe khadi hai.
sughra sa., koi bas raah guzar dhoond rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. qatra hi sahi koi tujhe paani pilade.
laila ki nazar aisa bashar dhoond rahi hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. gir gir ke shahe karbobala jalti zameen par.
ro ro ke faqat noor e nazar dhoond rahe hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. abbas tere nauhe ka pur dard hai misra.
akbar tujhe madar ki nazar dhoond rahi hai
az: Abbas razvi(anjuman e asghari)
